doc: The FX kinds (core/render/README.md). One spawn emits `count` particles from a pooled MultiMesh on the `fx` band of the actors canvas. shape is a placeholder analytic sprite in fx_ink.gdshader (disc, streak, burst, splat, bolt) until d4-production delivers the FX sheet. token: a palette.json id. Particles move on the 60 Hz tick: speed_mps along the spawn angle +- spread_deg/2 (a per-particle hash of the spawn serial, no RNG stream), slowed by drag per second, size grows by grow x per second, fading over life_ticks. light: a lights.json kind spawned with it ("" = none). Budgets: max_particles alive, max_spawns_per_frame; over budget a spawn is dropped and counted.

kinds.doc: the gun mouth: a paper star, 3 ticks
the round in flight: a paper streak along the shot
a hit on a wall or car: ink chips thrown back
a blast: paper puffs racing out, vermilion light rim
smoke: charcoal puffs that swell and drift
blood as ink: black splats that settle and stay a while
the electroshock melee crackle: paper bolts (teal is the dead's only)
